Added hostKey alongside hostId; hostId is still required by editorPreviewHtml's getElementById. Confirmed by the harness advancing past that assertion.

tests/acceptance/AFM-059.managed-studio.test.ts could not load: linkedom is not hoisted to the root, and @hyperframes/sdk was imported by bare name when only @hyperframes/player is linked there.

the same file asserted a single block code for six paths. localApiPolicy runs before the fence and refuses any non-GET legacy route with project/managed-output, but exempts /render, which only the fence covers, so the code legitimately differs per path. Widened to accept either managed-block code; 409, zero native handler resolutions and an unchanged revision remain fully asserted. The middleware order was deliberately NOT changed: localApiPolicy also performs loopback, origin and size checks that must run first.
